snippet.title: DEDALE - A Cave diving experience RELEASING TOMORROW
snippet.description:
In "Dédale", you will be playing as a famous blogger always on the lookout for new thrills and spine-chilling experiences.

Dive headfirst into the Beaver's Nest cave, commonly referred to as the "devil's throat" by the many urban legends and rumors that surround it.

Dédale is a short but intense cave diving experience in first person originally made for the 2025 edition of the Scream Jam.
